findings.title: RaUF coverage blocker is resolved
findings.evidence: RaUF is integrated as direct radar-uncertainty neighboring evidence. The text distinguishes anisotropic point-cloud covariance, CPR, transformation estimation, and ego-velocity from independent occupied/free/unknown calibration, ECE/Brier, future occupancy, and planning safety. It also records the static-scatterer condition in the Doppler consistency derivation and fine-tuning in part of the cross-domain evaluation.

findings.title: TriO claims, affiliations, formal status, and runtime are bounded by the primary paper
findings.evidence: The dedicated ECCV page contains the exact title, six authors, ECCV 2026 credit, and official Paper PDF, so peer-reviewed is now correct; no unverified chapter DOI is claimed. The primary paper confirms Waabi and University of Toronto affiliations. Production preserves the AV2 700/750 and STU 22 versus 2+19 inconsistencies, the custom STU ground/obstacle composition and optimal-F1 threshold, public AV2/STU without radar, unreleased LRR as the radar evidence, and the unsupervised-claim boundary. Table 10 confirms full TriO at 20k queries is 489.32 ms and 9915 MB on RTX 5000; 60.81 ms and 3449 MB belong to the no-camera ablation. Tangential-flow, warped-occupancy, weather, low-obstacle, and closed-loop limits are retained.

findings.title: RCVLA claims, authors, affiliations, and preprint boundary are correct
findings.evidence: The nine-author order and Tongji/ZJU/HKUST/UTokyo/SJTU affiliations match the primary paper. The record remains a preprint. Production separates semantic alignment from physical arbitration; treats 358185/161976 as QA samples rather than scenes; limits 0.576% to 0.175% to average open-loop collision proxies; exposes the semantic-only negative ablation against no radar (0.576% versus 0.391%); and records the constant-velocity/radial-TTC and reference-only delay protocol. No closed-loop, real-vehicle, formal safety, full-sensor-delay, or sequence-isolation claim is made.
